text:
alejandra: Quick sync — finalizing marketplace co-announce playbook with OurCloud + two SI partners. Need final signoffs: press embargo window, blog draft, marketplace listing copy, landing page hero assets, and SI onboarding checklist. Who can own what by EOD tomorrow?

jack: I can own the press timeline + blog publish flow. Can we confirm embargo time?

clare: prefer embargo 09:00 PT next Wed so journalists in NA have morning. that gives APAC afternoon. ok with product? :thinking_face: 

mina: 09:00 PT works. need to freeze the feature bullet list for the blog by Monday noon — engineers will need 24h to validate callouts.

rob: engineering can validate API/SDK callouts. pls point to exact endpoints we want to surface (hosted vs dedicated).

alejandra: We'll surface hosted API + dedicated capacity as options. Mina, I'll post the feature bullets in a sec. Rob — after you validate, can you push a staging snippet of the marketplace tile and the landing CTA?

rob: sure — will deploy staging tile. will need the hero image and short blurb. sizes?

jack: hero: 1440x600 png, 2MB max. blurb: 1 short sentence (15–20 words) + 2 bullets for benefits. CTA text: "Try on Redwood" and secondary: "Contact sales"

clare: PR draft is here: https://docs.google.com/draft/marketplace-coannounce (internal). Need quotes from OurCloud and SI leads. I pinged their comms.

mina: feature bullets: 1) unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private; 2) predictable latency + SLA; 3) cost-control tools (batching, cache, quantization recs). Rob — highlight which of these have benchmark numbers we can cite.

rob: we have latency p50/p95 for small text load and embedding throughput numbers. I'll attach a 1-line stat per bullet.

alejandra: legal check on partner logos and co-marketing terms — @clare please confirm once legal approves.

clare: looped in legal. quick note: OurCloud requires approval on the quote and logo usage. SI partner A also needs trademark review.

jack: blog/press timeline (draft):
```
Mon (T-6): finalize feature bullets + partner quotes
Tue (T-5): legal + partner logo approvals
Wed AM (T-4): staging landing up for internal review
Thu (T-3): marketing QA + analytics tagging (UTMs)
Fri (T-2): embargo brief to press list + embargoed press pack
Next Wed 09:00 PT: embargo lifts, publish blog + marketplace listing
```

mina: analytics tagging — we need UTM params doc and event names. Also flag for product telemetry team to ensure signup flow maps to marketplace CTA.

jack: I'll add UTM template to the drive. format: utm_source=press, utm_medium=blog, utm_campaign=ourcloud-launch-2026

rob: deploy-bot: Staging site deployed at https://staging.redwood.example/marketplace/ourcloud — tile and initial CTA live. (build #4572)

deploy-bot: build logs: 4572 succeeded in 3m12s; smoke tests passed.

alejandra: great — can folks do a quick review of the staging tile and landing copy by EOD? link: https://staging.redwood.example/marketplace/ourcloud (internal)

mina: reviewed — small copy tweak: change "predictable latency" to "SLA-backed latency" in hero; aligns with legal phrasing.

rob: validated SDK call examples. pushed minor fix to example request body (auth header note). recommend we include a short code snippet in the blog.

clare: partner quotes outstanding: OurCloud comms asked for 24h to approve. SI partner B asked for an alternate logo variant. I'm tracking both.

alejandra: owners and due dates:
- jack: press timeline + embargo list (due today EOD)
- clare: legal + partner asset signoffs (due Tue EOD)
- mina: finalized feature bullets + telemetry mapping (due Mon noon)
- rob: staging QA + short benchmark lines (due Mon EOD)

alejandra: blocking items: partner quote approvals, legal logo ok, final hero asset. If any blocker stays after Tue morning we'll consider moving embargo by 24h.

jack: question — for marketplace listing, do we use the same hero as the blog or a cropped variant? design prefers a cropped tile.

rob: staging currently uses cropped 1200x300 for marketplace tile; blog has 1440x600 hero. that's fine.

mina: quick checklist for SI onboarding doc (to attach to marketplace listing): connector compatibility (v1/v2), SCIM support, contact for handoff, expected lead time for integration (2–4 weeks), SSO notes. can someone draft?

clare: I can draft the SI one-pager. will include contact and handoff checklist.

alejandra: perfect. final ask: when we publish, please add canonical link from blog to marketplace listing and include press kit zip on the partner page. Also add link rel=canonical to prevent duplicate indexing.

jack: will add canonical and configure analytics. will send final publish checklist here once done. :thumbsup:

alejandra: thanks all — I'll follow up tomorrow with updated owners file and final staging link. if anything slips, call it out in this thread so I can escalate.

clare: noted. good momentum. :party_parrot:

rob: LGTM. will be available for QA tomorrow morning.

mina: thanks — will sync with product marketing on Monday to finalize bullets.

alejandra: closing the loop — next sync scheduled Mon 10:00 PT if we need a quick rollout review. otherwise update in thread.
